verdict: M177 r2 is a credible executable indexed-nonzero96 descriptor-consumer milestone: the r1 structural timing loop was caught fail-closed, the r2 split removes the observed loop, exact-SHA VCS/SVA and a fresh backpressure seed pass, and matched 3 ns logic-only DC costs only 0.413820 percent area over M175. It is not a physical, complete-FC2, system, or headline speedup because the native/preindexed producer, finite FIFO, descriptor memory, weight response, arithmetic, and exact-payload RTL composition are absent.

r1_dc_diagnostics: timing arc disabled to break loop (OPT-314)

r2_observed_split.residual_candidate_load: depends on group_slot_open, residual_valid_q and candidate_count only
r2_observed_split.scan_candidate_load: separately depends on scan_accept for new descriptors
r2_observed_split.residual_will_clear: depends on residual_candidate_load and candidate_remainder only
r2_observed_split.effect: the former scan_ready -> scan_accept -> candidate_load -> residual_will_clear -> scan_ready structural cycle is absent from current RTL

vcs_sva_audit.limitation: the directed descriptor population is synthetic and the legal done+EOT tail checks same-cycle acceptance and no protocol fault, but does not scoreboard the rearmed token's later done tag/had-event result

matched_logic_only_dc_audit.calculation: 1.0926702530364525 native/preindexed analytic transport ratio divided by 1.004138197274 logic-only area ratio

P0.finding: M177 consumes an already indexed nonzero stream but does not produce or store it. A posthoc one-beat-per-cycle raw96 scanner reverses the claimed transport win: 159,902,252 optimistic K4 cycles versus raw96 157,504,597, or 1.522 percent slower.
P0.impact: No M176/M177 latency ratio can be admitted as physical, complete-FC2, FFN, system, or headline speedup.
P0.required_closure: Implement an ATLIF-native index tap or a prebuilt sparse-index memory, finite FIFO/backpressure, and exact-payload producer-to-M177 miter; charge descriptor storage and port cycles.

P1.finding: The sealed VCS population is seven synthetic tokens rather than the frozen 120-payload/5.58M-token stream.
P1.required_closure: Materialize indexed descriptors from frozen payloads and replay them through producer plus M177 with conservation hashes.

P1.finding: The legal done+EOT test proves same-cycle acceptance and no protocol error, but the attack-phase scoreboard is disabled and the new zero token's eventual done tag/had-event is not checked.
P1.required_closure: Keep scoreboard enabled or add a dedicated post-rearm done assertion/check.

P1.finding: The loop-breaking r2 RTL has VCS and DC evidence but no RTL-to-mapped-netlist Formality receipt.
P1.required_closure: Run exact-SHA Formality for r2 before treating the mapped implementation as functionally closed.

P1.finding: DC uses ideal clock, ZeroWireload and zero macros; hold slack is only 0.0002 ns and there is no extracted interconnect, clock tree, macro response or placed route.
P1.required_closure: Preserve logic-only wording and later close with realistic SRAM/clock/interconnect context.

P2.finding: r2 DC logs two VER-318 signed/unsigned conversion warnings at beat-index/base-row reconstruction, although no current functional mismatch is observed.
P2.required_closure: Make widths and unsigned casts explicit, then rerun exact-SHA VCS/DC.

P2.finding: The official VCS runner hardcodes seed-specific stall and stream-hit counts, so it intentionally rejects a valid fresh-seed pass even when all conservation and SVA checks pass.
P2.required_closure: Keep the sealed precommitted seed receipt and add a separate invariant-based multi-seed regression gate.

P2.finding: The base contracts and structural correction overlay remain pre-run records with r2_vcs_sva/r2_loop_free_dc false; RUN_COMPLETE receipts carry the pass state.
P2.required_closure: Optionally add a non-mutating admission receipt overlay that points to both sealed RUN_COMPLETE hashes.

recommended_next_milestone: Do not iterate the consumer selector again. Build the smallest ATLIF-native indexed producer plus finite two-entry FIFO and descriptor-memory contract, exact-payload miter it into M177, and compare producer+consumer against M175 raw96 under the same port bandwidth. In parallel, add the missing rearm-completion check and r2 Formality. Only after producer-composed K4 remains faster should weight response and M169 accumulator context be attached.
